label: AI BUILDS
subtitle: Agents, chatbots and the tools I run on them.

items.name: Support Agent
items.desc: A triage agent that reads inbound tickets, answers what it can, and routes the rest with context attached.

items.name: Docs RAG Search
items.desc: Retrieval pipeline over client docs with citations — answers grounded in the source, not the model's imagination.

items.name: SEO Content Bot
items.desc: Keyword clustering to draft queue, producing briefs and outlines the team reviews before anything ships.

items.name: Lead Router
items.desc: Scores and assigns new leads in seconds, so speed-to-lead stops depending on who was awake.

items.name: Meeting Noter
items.desc: Joins calls, extracts decisions and action items, then files them straight into the CRM.
